entities.summary: Gangotri (Bhandari) Bist was a former olympian and international hockey player who played for the Indian Women's Hockey Team. She represented India at the 1980 Summer Olympics and 1982 Asian Games along with many other international tournaments. She had also been the vice captain for Indian Women's Hockey Team during the Asian Hockey Championship in Kyoto, Japan in 1981. Post her professional sports career - she worked for NWR Railways as chief office superintendent and lived with her beloved family in Jaipur, Rajasthan.
